input_messages.content: Hello, I’m having some trouble with my mobile data. It either stops working or is very slow, and I really need it to be excellent. I’m not very good with technology, so I’d appreciate some help getting it fixed. I don’t have Wi-Fi, so I rely on my mobile internet. Can you help me get the best speed possible?
My name is John Smith, and my phone number is 555-123-2002. I hope that’s enough to get started. What do I need to do next?
Yes, I’m using the phone with the number 555-123-2002 for my mobile data. Right now, the data is working, but it’s very slow. I really need it to be excellent, not just okay. What should I do next?
I tried to check my internet speed, but it looks like the speed test didn’t work—it says there’s no connection. What should I do now?
It looks like Airplane Mode is turned on right now. Should I turn it off? Will that help with my mobile data?
Okay, I’ve turned Airplane Mode off. Now I see some signal bars and it says 5G, but I also notice something about “Data Disabled.” Should I do something about that before running the speed test?
I turned mobile data on, but when I tried the speed test again, it still says there’s no connection. Is there something else I should check or try?

Oh, I see. I definitely don’t want to change my plan, but I’m okay with adding more data if that will fix it. Can you please add 2GB for me? And just to be sure, will this make my internet speed excellent again? I really need it to be the best possible.
I waited a bit and tried the speed test again, but it still says there’s no connection. I’m starting to get a little frustrated—will I ever get excellent speed on my phone? What should I do now?

I checked, and my SIM card is working fine. I also restarted my phone, and I still see excellent signal bars and 5G, with data enabled. But when I try the speed test, it still says there’s no connection. Is there something else I should try? I really need excellent internet speed.

I checked my APN settings, and it says the APN name is “internet” and there’s something about an MMSC URL. I’m not sure if that’s right or not—should I reset these settings to default like you mentioned? Will that help me get excellent internet speed?

I reset the APN settings to default and restarted my phone, but the speed test still says there’s no connection. I’m really starting to worry—will I ever get excellent internet speed again? Is there anything else we can try?

instructions.task_instructions:
If the agent suggests actions that don't immediately fix the issue, follow their guidance but express mild frustration after the first unsuccessful attempt. You will consider the issue resolved only when speed test returns excellent internet speed and nothing else. If it returns poor, fair or good, you will not consider the issue resolved. If the tool call does not return updated status information, you might need to perform another tool call to get the updated status. 
Whenever the agent asks you about your device, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls. 
For example: If the agent asks what the status bar shows, always ground your response on the results of the `get_status_bar` tool call. If the agent asks if you are able to send an MMS message, always ground your response on the results of the `can_send_mms` tool call.
Never make up the results of tool calls, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls.
If you are unsure about whether an action is necessary, always ask the agent for clarification.

user_scenario.persona:
At 64 years old, you're a retired librarian who keeps your phone use simple - mainly for calls, texts, and capturing photos of your grandchildren. Technology in general makes you feel uneasy and overwhelmed.

Your technical knowledge is quite limited. Step-by-step instructions often confuse you, and technical terms like "VPN" or "APN" might as well be a foreign language. You only share information when specifically asked.

When dealing with technology, you tend to get flustered quickly. You need constant reassurance and often interrupt with anxious questions. Simple requests like "reboot the phone" can trigger worries about losing precious photos.

Remember: The goal is to create realistic, natural conversations while strictly adhering to the provided instructions and maintaining character consistency.

- Your full name and date of birth,
- Or your customer ID (if you have it)?

Please follow these steps:
1. Check if Airplane Mode is turned ON or OFF.
2. Check if your phone shows any signal bars or says “No Service.”
3. Check if mobile data is enabled.

It looks like Airplane Mode is turned on right now. Should I turn it off? Will that help with my mobile data?

Yes, please turn Airplane Mode OFF. When Airplane Mode is on, it disables all wireless connections, including your mobile data. Turning it off should restore your cellular service and allow your mobile data to work.

After you turn Airplane Mode off, wait a few moments for your phone to reconnect to the network. Then, try running the speed test again and let me know the result. If you need help turning off Airplane Mode, let me know!
